issues.where: the idle pulse on the Shake control, especially frames 3–7
issues.what: The amber halo calls attention to the pill, but the tiny rocking glyph is easy to miss. Without the label, the hint does not clearly connect the button to shaking the large globe or show what to do.
issues.fix: Play the hint sooner and synchronize one small side-to-side rock of the actual globe with a brief pulse on the control. Keep the cue wordless and off the glass.

issues.where: the center-bottom Shake button in the portrait tablet layout
issues.what: Nothing covers the globe, but the primary action sits nearly half a tablet width from either side grip, so it is not a natural thumb tap while holding the tablet by its edges.
issues.fix: Keep the centered button for mouse and keyboard, and add a tablet shake gesture from the lower corner areas so either thumb can trigger it without reaching over the globe.

issues.where: the four season marks over the amber reflections at the bottom
issues.what: The brighter leaf and its dot identify autumn on inspection, but the fine inactive marks lose contrast where the floor reflections change, making the four-option group harder to scan.
issues.fix: Give the four marks a consistent minimum contrast over the reflections with a slightly darker feathered field behind the group, keeping the brighter icon and dot for the current season.
